headline: Global Markets Slip as Brent Crude Hits Five-Month High and Tech Shares Drop
summary: Technology shares dragged global markets lower as Brent crude reached a five-month high of nearly $112 a barrel. Analysts warned that an artificial intelligence crash could erase up to $20 trillion in U.S. market value.
why: Spikes in crude oil prices increase input costs across industries and fuel inflation fears, while concentrated market capitalization in mega-cap technology and AI stocks poses systemic risk to major equity indices.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Concerns over elevated capital spending and potential valuation pullbacks drove sharp declines in technology shares.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Higher oil futures and supply tightness pushed Brent crude prices to multi-month highs.

why_moved: Surging oil prices raise macroeconomic concerns regarding inflation and consumer spending, while heavy selling in high-flying tech stocks directly pressured major benchmarks like the Nasdaq and S&P 500.
